summary: Avoid a redundant canonical-key query for every named sparse harness observation when building native agent cards. Keys are resolved only for merging unnamed legacy observations or comparing a work overlay. A regression guard keeps SQL statement count constant as named sparse history grows; production latency acceptance remains separately measured.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill is required.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change.

rules.detail: Canonical order, runtime eligibility, sparse optional-field retention, explicit null clearing and work-overlay precedence remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The native card and status contracts and source fingerprints remain unchanged. This also applies when the agent collection view is disabled.

downtime.detail: No data migration or special downtime is required.

manual.detail: No new operator action is required.

recovery.detail: Historical cuts and existing authority, repair and source-availability fences remain unchanged.
